# sbom-diff

> Compare two CycloneDX 1.4-1.6 JSON SBOMs: added, removed, upgraded, downgraded components and license changes keyed by normalised purl, with CI exit codes. Python package `trysac-sbom-diff`, import name `sbom_diff`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
